2395.overview:
Target or be targeted!

1941 and the Two opponents. Two strategies. The year is scene is the Pacific. Japanese Zeros appear on the horizon, marking the beginning of World War II. From Pearl Harbor to unconditional surrender, this is your battlefield. PTO II delivers the power to control this infamous war. With new technology, faster and better war machines are at your disposal.

Command the guns of the mighty Missouri, launch devastating Japanese fighter attacks, or storm the beaches of Okinawa. India, Australia, and the east coast of the United States mark new regions for enemy domination. Three campaigns await the most ambitious of generals while single-ship engagements prepare you for more!

• Play one of three major campaigns or ten short scenarios
• Set your own victory conditions
• Select from 120 warships, 60 fighters & bombers, 20 submarines & 10 categories of tanks
• Command forces from 70 strategic bases around the globe
• Intercept & decipher enemy messages using technologically advanced weaponry
• Access biographies on WWII's most legendary heroes
• One or two player excitement

2459.overview:
Link 3 or more colored bubbles by shooting an identical colored bubble. When they are joined together, they pop.

This game completely abandons the idea of previous titles that the playfield is being pushed down by some sort of mechanical device and instead attaches groups of bubbles to nodes that move downwards. When a node is no longer connected to any bubbles it will disappear and when all nodes in a level have vanished the level is complete. One result of this change that may appear strange to players of previous versions is that shooting a bubble to the top of the visible playfield without striking any bubbles causes it to bounce and start travelling back downwards. The player is not penalised if such bubbles again leave the playing field without attaching to anything (except for adding to the number of moves until the field is pushed down by one empty line).

6828.overview: Enter the world of Panzer Dragoon Saga and experience a game like no other: a fusion of classic Panzer action with the most technologically advanced RPG to come to Saturn. Board your morphing dragon and behold as the mysteries of the Panzer world unfurl across four massive CDs. The new "rail free" 3D engine lets you soar deeper into role-playing adventure than you ever before imagined. Your destiny awaits.

7939.overview:
Select one of seven ferocious dinosaurs, then pound your opponents into submission as you battle for Urth Domination. Blizzard's Freeze Breath and Ice Geyser fighting moves stop you cold just before his Mega Punch hammers you senseless. Diabol's Inferno Flash cooks up a firestorm in one dino-barbecuing breath, and the foul, disgusting Chaos dazes you with an abundant supply of Power Puke, Farts of Fury, and Flying Butt Slams. Armadon's Gut Gouger and Gut Fling, Sauron's Cranium Crusher, Talon's Face Ripper, and Shredding and Vertigo's Scorpion Sting - every original arcade fighting and fatality move is at your fingertips! Get Ready to Rage!

• Plays just like the arcade game.
• Produced using stop-frame animation for life-like movement in fighting.
• Each player has unique fighting moves such as the Mega Punch, Flying Spikes and Jugular Bite.
• Spontaneous Punch combos: For heavy damage and quick kills!
• Grueling, long-lasting endurance and Tug-of-War game modes.
• All new, animated cinematic opening and victory sequence.

9260.overview: Thousands of years have passed since the Ancient Age; humanity struggles for survival in an unforgiving world. The player takes control of Kyle Fluge, a hunter caught up in a struggle between two dragons, and given an enormous task. Armed with an ancient gun and riding atop the Blue Dragon, you must battle against mutated wildlife, the covetous empire, and ancient sentinels, all for the sake of fulfilling the task entrusted to you by the Blue Dragon's prior rider - do not let the Black Dragon reach the Tower.

9261.overview:
Flash backwards to several years before the vicious battle against the Black Dragon in the original Panzer Dragoon. In a small village in the country of Meccania, coolias are bred for use as beasts of burden. Mutant coolias with glowing throats are killed, for they are bad omens, but one villager, Jean-Jacques Lundi, is unable to bring himself to kill his coolia Lagi - for Lagi has wings!
When an ancient ship arrives and destroys the village a year later, Lagi exhibits the ability to fire lasers from his mouth! Lundi and Lagi set out in pursuit of the ancient ship - for revenge, or perhaps for other reasons...

10571.overview:
Puzzle Bobble 2 is the first sequel to "Puzzle Bobble". It was entitled in Europe and North America as Bust-A-Move Again on the arcade and Bust-A-Move 2 on the home consoles. Released into the arcades in 1995, PlayStation, Sega Saturn, Nintendo 64 and PC conversions followed. The game was included in Taito Legends 2, but the US arcade version was included on US PS2 version instead. The game is a spin-off from Bubble Bobble.

The game builds on the original by adding a tournament style variation on the two player game for play against the computer and by adding a branching map to the one player game, allowing the player to periodically select one of two groups of five levels to play next, leading to different game endings. Some of the contestants in the new tournament mode are based on characters from Bubble Bobble, including variations on a Monsta and a Mighta.

Some versions of the game, including the PlayStation, feature time trial competitions in which a single player attempts to finish simple rounds quickly enough to beat previous time records or two players simultaneously attempt to beat the records and each other.

Completion of the single player game gives the player a code which can be entered to unlock 'Another World' for the single player game, which features subtle changes to the existing levels to increase their difficulty and changes to all backdrops to resemble levels from Bubble Bobble. The various enemies from Bubble Bobble also make an appearance in the background of the credits sequence.

11313.overview:
The young sorceress Nikki, the court jester Fargus, and his side-kick Sid the puppet are the three main protagonists of this 3D platform game. While attending a "Wizards in Training" seminar, Nikki accidentally casts a powerful magic spell, which results in a giant monsters swallowing the whole village. The three friends must now travel to a place called "Wishing Engine", and be granted a wish to revert the world back to normal.

The characters each have a special movement to kill enemies with. The game uses floating camera angles through a vast Prince of Persia-style world. The goal of the game is to clear the various levels, avoiding spikes and enemies and collecting coins for extra lives.

Unlike most 3D platformers, Pandemonium offers only two-dimensional movement, rather than complete freedom of movement. The characters move along a curving 2D course within a 3D environment.

11314.overview: This compilation collects the first two arcade incarnations of Konami's shoot'em'up parody series on one disc: Parodius: Non-sense Story and Fantastic Journey.

11315.overview: Up to six players can play a round of golf on the world-famous Pebble Beach golf course in Sega Sports' Pebble Beach Golf Links. It features seven play modes including Tournament, Stroke Play, Skins Play, and Match Play, and narration and strategy by golf pro Craig Stadler. You also have the option of creating your own player and selecting your own custom set of golf clubs to challenge Craig Stadler and other AI players on the course. Stats, such as handicaps and course records, are tracked throughout the game. Also, if you ever tire of taking on your friends and the AI, you can play the game in Watch Mode and simply lay back and watch Craig Stadler take on the competition on the Pebble Beach course.

11316.overview:
Players can choose to play as one of fourteen professional golfers such as Fuzzy Zoeller and Jim Gallagher Jr. or choose to create their own golfer by giving them a name and choosing what their golfer looks like from the few portraits that are available.

Players are then able to select what type of game mode they want to play. Game modes include letting the player practice a round of golf, compete in a tournament, have a shoot-out, or compete in a Skins game.

The game features two 18 hole golf courses to play at. Both platform versions of this game include the Sawgrass golf course, with each also including a unique golf course of their own. The Playstation version includes the Spanish Bay links, while the Saturn version includes the Spyglass Hill course.

When on the course, player select what club they want to use. They also can set the angle, pitch and backspin of the ball before taking a swing. They then have to aim where they want their shot to go. When shooting, players have to contend with the "Target Arc" power bar interface which effects the velocity and accuracy of each shot. This meter also factors the players risk in their shot by determining the degree of difficulty it would be to make the shot. Bold shots get rewarded while risky shots are not.

The game also features TV style commentary and several different camera angles, including a picture in picture view.

11317.overview:
An ancient evil force, neither of this time nor of this world, has remained buried since the Egyptians walked the earth. Now it has been exhumed. Of course, you, the hero, must find out what's going on in Egypt. Your helicopter crashes within this danger zone and you must survive on your own. Meet the Egyptian gods and follow their advice.

Exhumed is a first-person shooter set with an Egyptian theme. Twenty-one levels of finding six sacred objects with which you can jump higher, float under water, float and perform other heroics. Beat bosses and kill other creatures using eight weapons ranging from swords to guns to magic staffs.

Exhumed for the Playstation and Saturn consoles was released as Powerslave in the United States.

11318.overview: In this pinball simulation, you play on a table called "The Web". With the help of three flippers, you must send the ball into the various openings, trapdoors, and ramps. You can gain various bonuses (such as several balls to knock at the same time) if you play particularly well. Some of the targets activate special missions when you hit them with a ball. Those missions vary from aiming at specific targets to playing mini-games, such as shooting asteroids. After you have completed five missions, you'll be able to face the Dark Queen, the off-screen antagonist of the game.

23754.overview:
You play as the thirteen-year-old princess Gradriel, the daughter of Elfrenne, queen of Valendria. Twenty-five years ago Elfrenne destroyed the demonic forces that were threatening the country. Now the queen has died, and Gradriel is proclaimed to be the future savior of the land, as it was not entirely purged of all evil. And indeed, an evil spirit has secretly invaded Valendria and is trying to take control over Gradriel's two older sisters. Will the young princess succeed in defeating the evil?

This is an action/platform RPG, somewhat similar to the third game in Ys series. The entire game world is a side-scrolling platform on which fights, exploration, and conversation with the NPCs take place. The combat is detailed and contains elements of fighting games. Although the princess develops like a RPG protagonist, she can also use various physical moves in combat: kick, dash, defend, crouch, etc.

23765.overview:
In the year 2010 mankind has built its first space colony, Beyond Coast. Three years later the founders of the colony felt it needed to be protected, and chose five best policemen from Earth to do that: Gates Becker from Scotland Yard, the Japanese Sadaoki Tokugawa, Salvatore Toscanini from New York, and two policemen from Los Angeles: Jonathan Ingram and his best friend Ed Brown. During a routine patrol on Beyond Coast, something happened to Jonathan's space suit. He was sucked into space and presumed dead. Twenty-five years later, he is miraculously discovered in his life pod, alive. He still looks like a young man, but in reality he is fifty-five years old.

Trying to forget his past, Jonathan opens an investigation agency on Earth. One day, his ex-wife unexpectedly pays him a visit. She has re-married during Jonathan's prolonged absence, and asks him to find her missing husband. When she leaves the office, her car explodes, and she dies. Determined to fulfill her final request, Jonathan prepares to re-visit Beyond Coast.

Policenauts is a Japanese-style adventure with action elements, similar in many ways to Snatcher. The player interacts with the environment in a point-and-click fashion: positioning a cursor over an object allows the player character to examine it or perform other context-dependent actions. There are a few puzzles in the game, but most of the time the story is advanced by visiting various locations, examining objects, and talking to characters. Conversations usually include a selection of topics.

Action sequences are similar to those of Snatcher, but are more numerous and varied. The player must rapidly shoot enemies moving within a one-screen area viewed from a first-person perspective, reloading the gun manually and trying to eliminate the enemy before Jonathan's health bar is depleted.

Policenauts Saturn version has differences with its PlayStation counterpart:

• The game's glossary from policenauts.net can be accessed in game by pressing Z or Start buttons.
• Shooting mode that supports Virtua Gun/Stunner peripheral. You must first clear the scenes ins story mode to access them.
• More scenes.
• Dialog is altered in some scenes.
• Additional character close-ups.
• When touching girls breasts they bounce longer... the PS1 version has censored bouncing.
• Bonus videos after completing the game.
• Anime cut-scenes run at 24FPS vs 15 FPS on PS1, but quality is lower.

29253.overview: The object of this head-to-head puzzle game is to clear your grid of falling patterns called puyos by forming chains of four or more same-colored puyos in a straight line or one of several geometric patterns. What makes this a challenging two-player contest is the fact that when you clear a chain of puyos from your grid, it drops a random piece of filler onto your opponent's grid. The more puyos you clear, the more you fill your opponent's grid, and if you can clutter up his grid enough to fill it to the top, you've won the game.

31100.overview:
Psychic ninja Taroumaru and his partner Enkai set off to vanquish the supernatural forces that threaten the Japanese countryside. You must battle through several stages of side-scrolling action set in feudal Japan, dealing with all sorts of undead horrors and saving villages from rampaging demons.

Your weapons are your psychic powers, which allow you to lock onto enemies and channel energy bolts to destroy them. You can power-up your basic attack with collectible power-ups and you can also take psychic control of several weaker enemies to watch your back while you fight, grapple, jump and climb through the stages.

Graphics are 2D with polygonal elements used for some background elements. Supports up to two player cooperative gameplay.

31326.overview:
Puzzle & Action: 2do Arukoto wa Sand-R (Puzzle & Action: Treasure Hunt) is the third and final instalment in the Puzzle & Action series, after Puzzle & Action: Tant-R and Puzzle & Action: Ichidant-R. Like the previous games, players play a series of timed mini games to overcome enemies.

Gameplay is similar to the previous games, although the games are in 3D. There are four rounds of a number of timed mini games, and two players are supported. Twenty-two categorized mini games are featured, and like the previous instalments, there is a 'Free Play' mode where they can be practiced. The Saturn version features a RPG-style 'Original mode', which features a shop where items such as torches and brooms can be purchased.

31522.overview:
A hero saved the human race from utter annihilation by the gods. This same hero then was charged by the heavens to take care of young seed dropped from there. This seed becomes his daughter, and her guardian will be watching her progress.

In Princess Maker 2 the player assumes the role of a father to the blessed daughter of the heavens. For the next eight years, the hero will nurture and guide her in the path of the player's own choosing.

It is possible to choose the path of the zodiac-influenced daughter by scheduling her to jobs and schools, which will raise her statistics (strength, combat skills, cooking, faith, etc.) Each month allows the player to designate three different tasks for her to follow. Balancing between character development, stress level, health and financial income is the focus of this game.

Mini sub-quests and various plot options revolve around the young lady adventuring in the wilderness, provided that she's strong enough to tame the wilds. The player can equip her with armor and weapons to fight off wandering random monsters in turn-based combat.

The game starts with the daughter at age ten, from which point the player guides her until her adult years. Choices made during the course of the game will determine her eventual marital status, accomplishments and her relationships with other people. There are 74 unique endings in the game.

107709.overview:
In Purikura Daisakusen, the Miracle Kingdom has been invaded by an evil mechanical army, all of its inhabitants have been magically transformed into animals, and the queen has been imprisoned. Taking on the role of either the gallant knight Grey, or one of the queen's sisters Kurara or Kirara, the player must reach the queen and save the land while demolishing any creature that stands in their way.

The game plays as an isometric scrolling shooter, in which the player must navigate their chosen character through stages, killing enemies with magic attacks while collecting power-ups and other unique items. Attacks can be melee or ranged, with each being capable of being upgraded via power-ups, and a dodge ability allows the player to avoid most basic attacks. Each character also has a "super" form, which becomes available with enough magic energy. The player also has a familiar with them at all times, which gradually evolves and increases its powers with each enemy defeated.

Features simultaneous 2-player cooperative gameplay and a bonus gallery mode with a fully-voiced commentary option.

128064.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 10: Masaki Mai is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Mai Masaki. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.

128091.overview: Playboy Karaoke Collection Volume 1 (プレイボーイカラオケVol.1) is a 1996 compilation of karaoke music videos with Playboy models in the background released by VIC Tokai for the Sega Saturn exclusively in Japan. A second volume was also made.

129166.overview: Hebereke's Popoitto is a Tetris variant. The goal in each level is to remove the blocks already on the playfield, representing characters from the franchise. Other blocks fall down from the top of the screen and have to be steered to the right place before touching the ground or another block. When four or more of the same blocks are together, they vanish. The catch of this variant is that the blocks which have to be removed move over the playfield. The player takes the role of the penguin Hebereke who wants to win a tournament against his friends.

129170.overview:
This pinball game has a 3D orientation in which the camera pans vertically wherever the ball moves or sometimes shows a closeup of the ball in rails and sinkholes. There are three different pinball tables:

• Basketball Legend - Has the theme of a basketball court with coach-styled messages.
• Card Master - Based on a casino theme, featuring poker and roulette.
• Circus Fantasia - Displays a circus-styled theme with scoring for stunts.

The two modes in the game are the pinball mode, which feature only the pinball tables for the highest score or the story mode. In the story mode, a crippled basketball college student goes to a bar where he is inspired to become the best pinball champion player in the United States. The career-styled gameplay requires the player to make use of limited funds to make purchases, travel between cities and resting to stay healthy. Money is earned by beating opponents' scores in pinball or by winning a basketball mini-game.

134730.overview: What happens when you take several signature Capcom fighters, squish them down into chibi (small or SD) versions of themselves, and give them a whole collection of wacky moves and over-the-top costumes? You get Pocket Fighter! Take on one of several pint-sized Capcom characters in this wacky, colorful fighting game.

135869.overview:
Puyo Puyo Sun is the third entry in the main Puyo Puyo series of real-time puzzle games, its title being a pun involving the Japanese word for "three". The evil Dark Prince has caused the sun to augment its size and power to dangerous levels, and thus the Puyo Puyo world is on the verge of being scorched unless you prevent it.

The game features three distinct story campaigns, each pitting you against a different set of enemies which you must battle in classic Puyo Puyo fashion: In each stage you face off against an opponent in two different play areas, one for you and one for your opponent. As the blob-like "puyos" start falling in your play area, you must align them and create groups of the same color in order to clear the screen before you get flooded with puyos. Chaining puyos of different colors allows you to send several "garbage" puyos to the opposing player's play area in hopes of either flooding it, or slowing his advance, and whoever defeats the opposing player moves on to the next challenger.

New for Puyo Puyo Sun are the Sun Puyos, which can be added to combos for extra damage. Also includes 2P vs gameplay, challenge modes and galleries and other bonus features.

140894.overview:
Joshikousei no Houkago... Pukunpa is a falling-block puzzle game featuring a cast of cute anime girls who each represent a different school club.

The game plays very similarly to the popular Puyo Puyo series, with colored blobs falling in pairs which must be rotated and arranged by the player. Matching three or more blobs of the same color will cause them to vanish, allowing any stacked above them to fall down and potentially trigger a chain that will send garbage blocks to the opponent. The unique feature here is that some blobs actually contain two different colors; these pieces cannot be cleared on their own, but when a neighboring piece is cleared the double piece expands, releasing the two colored blobs from inside, and allowing for further chain attack potential. If the pieces stack all the way to the top of the well, then that player loses the round.

The game includes two game modes: a versus mode against the computer or a second player, and an endless mode for one or two players. The game also includes an alternate "Funny Mode" which replaces the anime-style girls with crudely-drawn fantasy characters.

141006.overview: Pappara Paoon is a competitive color-matching puzzle game. Two players at opposite ends of a playfield launch colored pieces at a group of blocks; if four or more pieces of the same color are matched, all connected pieces of the same color are removed from play. Certain pieces will place garbage pieces on the opposing player's side of the board or shift the entire playfield in one direction, and if the pieces reach all the way to one end of the playfield, that player loses. The game includes both a single-player campaign mode and a two-player versus mode.

141007.overview:
Pastel Muses is a puzzle game where you shoot colored balls down a slope to match them up with the pile of balls at the bottom. The premise is similar to such games as Puzzle Bobble, but with a difference. Here you not only control the aim, but also how hard you shoot the ball, making it go in an arc across the playing field and down the slope. Also, when you make balls disappear the remaining balls fall further down the slope using somewhat good physics.

You can play the game in the usual Story Mode, vs Mode and Endless Mode varieties usually found in this kind of puzzler.

141009.overview:
PD Ultraman Link is a falling-block puzzle game featuring the Japanese superhero Ultraman and many of his allies and foes. Blocks of various colors fall into the well in pairs; each block has two connections, and connecting three or more blocks together regardless of color will cause them to disappear. Any blocks above the ones removed will fall into the now-open space, potentially creating chain combos which will send garbage blocks that must be cleared twice to the opponent. Additionally, connecting four blocks of the same color will clear all blocks of that color from the board, while connecting four each of a different color together will clear all the garbage blocks on the screen by one stage. If the blocks stack past the line at the top of the well, that player loses the match.

The game includes a single-player story mode, as well as a free battle mode against the computer or another player. There are 10 different characters to choose from: five Ultra Heroes and five aliens.

141010.overview: Planet Joker is a vertically-scrolling shoot-em-up with a strong story presentation. A mysterious army has invaded Tokyo, and it's up to a special crack team of JSDF mech pilots to defeat the invaders. The player chooses from one of seven different mech suits, each of which has different stats and a different set of attack abilities. In addition to regular shots and bombs, there is also a charged shot, and three different weapon types which can be swapped and upgraded by collecting items throughout each of the seven stages. There are also two competition modes: a time-attack mode to reach a set score as quickly as possible, and a caravan-style score attack mode with a time limit.

141012.overview:
Pro Mahjong Kiwame S is a 4-player riichi mahjong game and part of Athena's long-running Pro Mahjong Kiwame series. As is standard for the series, it features the endorsement of the Japan Professional Mahjong League and includes the likenesses of 16 professional mahjong players.

The main arcade mode gives the player a choice of four different routes throughout Japan. Each stage on a route involves a match against specific real-life pro players, and the player must earn a set number of points in order to proceed to the next stage. The Saturn home version of the game adds a free match mode, a mahjong quiz mode, and an "analysis" mode where the player must select the correct moves for certain situations.

141023.overview:
Kanzen Chūkei Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine ("Complete Broadcast Pro Baseball Greatest Nine") is a baseball game featuring featuring an NPB (Nippon Professional Baseball) license and all twelve teams and all players from the Central and Pacific Leagues of Japanese baseball for the 1995 season. It is the first game in Sega's flagship Greatest Nine series of Sega Saturn baseball games.

It is presented in a realistic visual style, including digitized photographs of all players. Several game modes are available, including Open Game (Exhibition), Pennant Race, and Tournament modes, as well as All-Star Game and Home Run Contest modes. The game also features a full Team Edit mode and a player information database.

A modified version featuring American MLB teams and players was released worldwide as World Series Baseball.

141024.overview:
Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine '97 is a baseball game featuring featuring an NPB (Nippon Professional Baseball) license and all twelve teams and all players from the Central and Pacific Leagues of Japanese baseball for the 1997 season, and the third game in Sega's Greatest Nine series of Sega Saturn baseball games.

The game features an overhauled visual style that uses fully-3D player models instead of the digitized sprites of the previous two games. Available modes are Open Game (Exhibition), Pennant Race, and Home Run Contest — the Tournament and All-Star modes have been removed. The Team Edit mode also returns, though the player database is no longer available. The Nagoya Dome and Osaka Dome stadiums — brand new at the time of the game's release — have also been added to the available real-life stadiums.

A modified version featuring American MLB teams and players was released internationally as World Series Baseball 98.

141025.overview: Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine '97: Make Miracle is an updated release of baseball game Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine '97. This version adds a "1997 Pennant" mode that recreates the actual events of the 1997 season, updates the player rosters, and allows for changing the camera viewpoint during play. It is otherwise nearly identical to the original version of the game.

141026.overview:
Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine '98 is a baseball game featuring featuring an NPB (Nippon Professional Baseball) license and all 12 teams and all players from the Central and Pacific Leagues of Japanese baseball for the 1998 season, and the fourth main game in Sega's Greatest Nine series of Sega Saturn baseball games.

The game is very similar to the previous year's entry, featuring the same visual style and all of the same game modes: Open Game (Exhibition), Pennant Race, Home Run Contest, and Team Edit. New in this entry is the so-called Narikiri Mode, a variant of Pennant Race where instead of controlling a full team, the player picks a single player from one team to control.

141027.overview: Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine '98: Summer Action is an updated release of baseball game Pro Yakyū Greatest Nine '98. This version updates the player rosters to the most current data as of the end of the 1998 season, adds additional original teams and additional management features to the Narikiri Mode introduced in the previous release. It is the last entry in the series to appear on the Sega Saturn.

141028.overview:
Pu-Li-Ru-La is a psychedelic side-scrolling arcade beat 'em up set in the magical land of Radishland. As the story goes, some evil magical entity has stolen the keys of time for the towns in Radishland, freezing time and turning every animal and creature into evil magical contraptions. Only Zac and Mel, empowered with their "invented magic sticks" are able to escape the curse and must thread through Radishland turning all the monsters back into their original form and recovering the keys of time.

Gameplay-wise the game is a side-scrolling beat 'em up in which you control your character in a 2.5D isometric plane as he clears each stage by beating the many wacky enemies with his stick and a few magic spells that are randomly selected whenever you start the game. At the end of each stage there is a harder "boss" creature you must defeat and upon doing so you proceed to the next stage.

The game is notable for its surreal graphic design, featuring digitized graphics merged with hand-drawn sprites and featuring mostly colorful nonsensical graphics. Features single player or co-op two-player gameplay modes.

157034.overview:
An idol group known as Otomegumi (乙女組) is staying at the western-style boarding house in a spa resort in Izu (伊豆), Japan. You, Takeshi Gouda (郷田 武史), as a professional photographer came, along with your team which includes Ryouichi Akada (赤田 良一), your editor, and Takuya Sasaki (佐々木 拓也), your young assistant, to make a photo album of that very idol group. As you arrive at the boarding house you meet with Otomegumi idol group consisting of Rei, Maki, and Shouko, as well as with some other suspicious looking characters on the premise. Due to a sudden storm, you decide to wait it out and use that opportunity to get to know everyone a little better. But the evening doesn't go as well as expected and some unpleasant words are exchanged with Seiji Tashiro (田代 成治), an idol group manager. Ryouichi had to step in a couple of time to prevent things from escalating, but by the time everyone went to bed it all seemed to have quiet down.

Next morning, you, the idol group, Ryouichi, Takuya, and Chieko Naemura (苗村 千恵子) who is a stylist for Otomegumi idol group all went to hot springs for some photo session. The photos are going fine and things were about to wrap up when the distressing rumor about someone being dead back at the boarding house have reached you. You all pack your things and head back to the boarding house. There, you find the owners of the boarding house, Kyousuke Nakagawa (中川 京介) and his wife Reiko Nakagawa (中川 麗子), standing in front of a room of none other than Seiji Tashiro who was a troublemaker since the moment you met him. At closer inspection you soon realize it's a murder as he appears to have been stabbed with a knife. But who would have a reason to kill him? Suspects... motives... opportunities... anyone could be the killers, and to top it all, you cannot call the police as phone line appears to be dead. With the killer among you, what was to be a nice relaxing vacation is turning into a murder mystery that is far from being over.

The game plays like a straight visual novel consisting of text over current background which is comprised on many photo stills to match the dialogue and emotion of the scene in question. Occasionally the player is presented with dialogue choices which may affect the current situation but there is no real branching in the main story, just different reactions by the people addressing you. Voice-acting is almost non-present and appears only in key dialogues between the player and the idols, and usually for no more than a single short sentence. In photo session player can take a limited number of photos but does not control camera movement, instead, camera moves up and down once and the player has the chance to take a photo or keep the movie to use on the next pose. Limited bonus contained in a package is an envelope containing an actual photo from one of the photo sessions in the game.

157129.overview: Pachinko Hall: Shinsou Daikaiten is a business simulation game where the player runs a chain of pachinko parlors. The protagonist takes over the business from their father after his retirement, and starting from a single location, the goal is to grow the business enough within 20 years to take the company public and list it on the stock exchange. Using a menu-based system, the game includes detailed simulation of all aspects of operating a pachinko hall franchise, from obvious elements such as hiring employees and determining prizes and payouts, to more esoteric elements such as negotiating loans and obtaining the proper government permits to open new locations.

157132.overview:
Kengo is an average guy working at a video rental store. One day, his boss asks him to make an ad for recruiting female employees for the store, hoping that a cute face at the counter might help business. While Kengo is working on the ad on his computer, a cute girl suddenly appears on the screen; this rather flustered and excitable young lady introduces herself as Panic, and before long she appears in the real world and starts working at the video store. However, while she might attract customers, she also attracts trouble, and soon another mysterious lady starts appearing on video screens. Just who are these two girls, and what is their connection?

Panic-chan is a visual-novel style adventure game with a focus on animated sequences; it describes itself as an "OVA adventure" and includes 90 minutes of original animation. Most of the game proceeds in a linear format, with each scene playing out through dialogue and animation; there are occasionally choices of which action the protagonist should take, which will branch the story and lead to different scenes.

157133.overview:
Photo Genic is a love adventure game in which the player takes the part of a budding professional photographer. The protagonist is skilled at landscape photography, but has been tasked by his editor to prepare a gallery for an upcoming photo contest. The subject for this contest is photos of young girls, and so the protagonist must both find models and learn how to properly photograph them within the one-year deadline before the contest.

The player must determine their schedule for each week; as a professional photographer, the protagonist works five days a week and can use those days to train different aspects of their craft or to work various jobs in order to make money to buy supplies. On the weekend, the player is given one free day to visit locations around town, looking for models and eventually doing photo shoots. There are three different girls to approach, and the player's relationship with that girl will affect both their suitability and willingness as a model. During shoots, the player can choose the background, posing, and framing for the shoot.

157134.overview: The third main installment (and fourth game in all) in Gainax' Princess Maker simulation series. A young fairy wants to become a human princess. The fairy Queen first refuses to fulfill her wish, but the fairy becomes so upset that the Queen finally decides to make her reborn as a princess, and entrusts her future to you. You are the one responsible for what the little princess will become. You can give her a good education, let her study a lot, fight, develop her sense for arts, etc. The princess will go to school and make friends and rivals, and live her life to the full according to your plans.

157135.overview:
Another game in Infogrames' line of H. P. Lovecraft inspired games started by Alone In the Dark, Prisoner of Ice puts you in the role of Lt. Ryan, an American agent stationed aboard the submarine H.M.S. Victoria on a rescue mission to the Antarctic. The Victoria picks up two mysterious crates during the course of the rescue. Before you know it the Captain is eaten alive by the cargo, a horrific monster with whom you are trapped aboard the submarine. And that's just the start of your problems.

Prisoner of Ice features a very simplified version of the classic adventure game interface, where you can left click with the cursor to operate an object or right click to look at it. The program won't let you do anything with these objects, other than the few appropriate actions needed to advance the game.

157136.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 1: Kinoshita Yuu is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Yuu Kinoshita. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame. Winning three rounds of the minigame will unlock a bonus video.

157137.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 6: Yoshida Satomi is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Satomi Yoshida. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.

157138.overview: Pro Yakyuu Team mo Tsukurou! ("Let's Make a Pro Baseball Team, Too!") is a baseball management simulation game spun off from Sega's better-known soccer management series. Selecting one of the 12 teams from the Japanese professional leagues, the goal is to build that team into the greatest baseball team in the world. Many aspects of managing a team are simulated and under control of the player, from hiring players and staff, determining training schedules and strategies before games, to even managing the team's finances and constructing facilities. The player can also create multiple custom players to sign to their team and train, and it is also possible to host an exhibition match against another player's team using a password function.

157139.overview:
The Psychotron is an adventure from the early development time of live video, set in a wild Texan environment. A sort of Mission Impossible type of game with much usage of live video.

You have been assigned by the US President and the FBI to find out a missing official science project. The video interaction is very sharp and the game also offers the player many puzzles, card and board game sequences.

157140.overview:
Five young goddesses have been summoned on the orders of God: there's a shortage of guardians on Earth, and to decide who among them is fit to protect the people of Earth, these goddesses must prove their abilities through a test of leadership and compassion.

Pup-Breeder is a simulation game where the player takes the role of one of the goddesses, who is tasked with raising angelic creatures called "pups". These pups come in many different forms, which each have their own abilities and personalities — some may be good at fighting, some may have strong defense, some might have high agility or other unique skills — and the player starts out by selecting a team of five. Each of the pups functions like a virtual pet-style creature, tracking not only its health but also its trust and affection with the player.

The player character does not appear directly in the world or control the pups directly, but rather can issue commands to each of the pups such as to move or stop, use an item, attack a target, or activate a special ability. There are a variety of different missions which each have a different goal, such as causing the sun to rise, collecting shards of shooting stars, or defeating an evil familiar.

158063.overview:
Panzer Dragoon Playable Preview (unnamed in Europe) is a demo disc containing a shortened version of Panzer Dragoon for the Sega Saturn. Only episode 2 is playable, and is assumed to be identical to the full product.

This disc was bundled with Saturn consoles for a short period in both North America and Europe. It was not released elsewhere, nor did it see a separate commercial release.

174592.overview:
A boy named Kerun lives a rather boring life. One night, he spots a shooting star in the sky and makes a wish, but winds up getting more than he bargained for! The star hears him and appears before him to grant his wish, and he's whisked away through a portal to the land of Paneltia, where he must take up a sword and become the hero of this fantastic realm.

Paneltia Story is a Japanese-style RPG with a twist: the world the player explores isn't fixed, but rather is constructed by the player as it is being explored. The player collects various "panels" representing different locations and types of terrain from enemies, item boxes, and shops; these can be placed on the map to create new areas to explore and find yet more panels. The game is divided up into stages, with the goal of each stage generally being to build up enough experience and strength to defeat a boss hidden somewhere in the map. Battles are turn-based affairs in the style of Dragon Quest, with the player controlling only the lone protagonist.

174844.overview:
Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! 2 is a dating simulation game and a follow-up to the first game. Set four years later, the Pia Carrot restaurant has proved successful, and a second location has now opened. High school senior Kōji Maeda needs a part-time job over the simmer, and winds up working at the restaurant and living in its dormitory alongside numerous cute ladies.

Gameplay is quite similar to the previous title, with the player determining Kōji's schedule and actions for each day. Work days are decided each Thursday for the following week, and each day is divided into three sections. In the morning, Kōji can take various actions such as to study, exercise, or visit various locations around town. In the afternoon, he must go to work, and different tasks will improve different attributes. In the evening, he can approach one of the girls to strike up a conversation. There are a total of eight possible romantic interests to pursue, and Kōji's attributes will determine which girls will be interested in him.

This Sega Saturn port of Pia Carrot e Yōkoso!! 2 adds one new romance option (Tomomi Aizawa) and significant new scenario content compared to the original PC release. This version also censors the explicit sexual content.

174845.overview:
In Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! the player controls Yusuke Kinoshita, a 18-year-old male Japanese high-school student. He intends to have a cool summer vacation, but realizes he has no money. Having no choice, he takes a job in his father's restaurant, "Pia Carrot". Thus begins an adventure much more exciting than the summer vacation he has dreamed about: he gets to know many beautiful girls in the restaurant, and has to decide which one is the love of his life...

The game is a true dating simulation, with the gameplay focusing on making schedules and choosing activities for the protagonist. In the beginning of each day, the player typically choose an action before it's time to go to work. These actions range from giving a call to any of the girls the hero meets during the game, going to different locations, simply resting, etc. While at work, the player should make a schedule for Yusuke, sending him to work in different places (kitchen, basement, counter, etc.). After work, it's time to choose which girl to talk to. There are also many events that prompt the player to choose an action or a conversation option.

All these actions influence Yusuke's statistics, ultimately making him more (or less) attractive to the various girls he meets on his path. Depending on the way the player shapes and schedules the activities of the main character, he will follow one of the many different narratives, meet different people, and eventually - if the player is persistent enough - win the heart of the girl he loves.

174846.overview: Private Idol Disc: Data-Hen Race Queen F is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Sada Soft, which was released in Japan in 1996.

174849.overview: Private Idol Disc: Data Hen Race Queen G is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Sada Soft, which was released in Japan in 1997.

174850.overview: Private Idol Disc Tokubetsuhen: Cosplayers is a multimedia photobook of female cosplayers. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors style minigame themed like a 1-on-1 fighting game. Winning the minigame will unlock bonus videos.

174851.overview: Private Idol Disc: Tokubetsu-Hen Kogyaru Daijyakka 100 is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Genki, which was released in Japan in 1997.

174854.overview: Private Idol Disc Tokubetsuhen: Can Gal '97 is a multimedia photobook of so-called "campaign girls", who are models who appear in advertising and corporate promotion. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of 18 girls, as well as a quiz minigame with 10 questions. There is no bonus reward for completing the minigame.

174855.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 2: Uchiyama Miki is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Miki Uchiyama. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame. Winning three rounds of the minigame will unlock a bonus video.

174858.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 3: Ooshima Akemi is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Akemi Ooshima. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame. Winning three rounds of the minigame will unlock a bonus video.

174859.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol.4: Kuroda Mirei is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Mirei Kuroda. It includes a gallery of photos and interview questions, as well as a simple quiz minigame with questions about the idol. Clearing all rounds of the quiz will give the player a password and instructions to enter a prize drawing with Genki's publishing label SadaSoft.

174860.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 5: Fujisaki Nanako is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Nanako Fujisaki. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will give the player passwords to unlock bonus photos.

174861.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 7: Asou Kaori is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Kaori Asou. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.

174863.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 8: Furukawa Emiko is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Emiko Furukawa. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.

174864.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 9: Nagamatsu Keiko is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Keiko Nagamatsu. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.

174865.overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 11: Hirose Mayumi is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Mayumi Hirose. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.

175486.overview:
A writer named Adrienne Delaney has just moved into an old mansion with her photographer husband Donald. Shortly after moving in, Adrienne begins to experience horrifying nightmares and have odd encounters inside the creepy old abode. Furthermore, the house is having a severe effect on her husband, changing him for the worse. Adrienne must discover the secret of the house before the unknown force consumes her husband, and unravel the terrible events that have happened in the past.

Phantasmagoria is an adventure game that places heavy emphasis on full motion video for exposition and cutscenes at various junctures to advance the storyline. Adrienne is represented as a digitized character roaming around pre-rendered settings in the house. She inspects various rooms, finds items, adds them to her inventory, finds places to use the items, and triggers advancements in the plot.

Puzzle-solving element is present, though reduced compared to most other adventure games made by Sierra. There are seven chapters in the game, as well as a status screen that tracks the player's progress within the chapter. If the player happens to get stuck in the game, a talking skull icon who identifies himself as the hintkeeper can supply the player with hints on request. It is possible to start playing the game from any chapter.

Phantasm is notable for shipping on 8 Saturn discs (one more than the PC version) - more than any other game in the console's library.

175487.overview: Pict Flash Dondon (ピクトフラッシュどんどん) is an educational software for the Sega Saturn for children of ages 1 to 6 years old.

175499.overview: Playboy Karaoke Collection Volume 2 (プレイボーイカラオケvol.2) is a 1996 compilation of karaoke music videos with Playboy models in the background released by VIC Tokai for the Sega Saturn exclusively in Japan. A first volume was also made.

175503.overview:
In the Kingdom of Dilma, dignitaries from many other nations have gathered for the coronation of the new king. However, before the ceremony takes place, a treasure of the kingdom, a priceless jewel integral to the ceremony, has been stolen from the prince's bedroom. The suspect fled into the castle's dungeon, and the prince went after them but has not returned. There are five suspects who do not have an alibi: five beautiful princesses from other countries. The young knight Willow has been summoned to investigate, find the thief, and recover the stolen jewel.

Princess Quest is a first-person dungeon-crawler RPG with love adventure elements. The player controls Willow to investigate the theft, and Willow is also able to magically transform into a female form called Will. Willow and Will have different combat abilities, with Willow adept at physical attacks while Will excels at magic, and during the investigation some characters will only be willing to speak openly to one form or the other. The player can return to Willow's room in the castle to switch forms.

The player can explore the castle and surrounding town from a top-down perspective to speak with other characters and obtain clues and information. The dungeons are explored in first-person with up to two of the princesses accompanying the player. Only Willow/Will participates directly in the turn-based combat, while the other two characters provide special abilities to help the player.

The first-print limited edition of the game includes a set of three trading cards but is otherwise identical.

175504.overview: Pyon Pyon Kyaruru no Mahjong Hiyori is a family-friendly 1-on-1 style mahjong game featuring a cast of cutesy cartoon characters. Gameplay is a straightforward translation of Japanese-style reach mahjong with no notable additional features, and includes both a story mode with five playable (plus one unlockable) characters and a free match mode, along with a gallery featuring unlockable artwork of the characters.

175505.overview:
Pro Mahjong Tsuwamono is a mahjong game featuring the likenesses of 16 professional players. There is a free battle mode against any selection of pro players, a tournament mode with three different titles to earn, a parlor mode with six different specific situations, and a mahjong guidance mode that advises players on how to improve their mahjong gameplay.

While each version of the game varies in audiovisual presentation and title, all versions include the same selection of game modes and feature the same 16 professional players.

181325.overview:
Pad Nifty (パッドニフティ) is a piece of Sega Saturn software released exclusively in Japan. It was used to access Fujitsu's now defunct NIFTY-Serve network. Sega had a presence on NIFTY-Serve with their Sega Game Information Station, with the network having previously hosted dedicated Sega bulletin boards.

It is completely reliant on the Sega Saturn Modem (of which it was bundled with) and the defunct NIFTY-Serve network, as such it cannot function in the modern age.

182913.overview: This special release of Puyo Puyo Sun is modified to exclusively support online multiplayer functionality via the Sega Saturn Modem and XBand service. Released at a lower price, most of the single-player content has been removed from this version, with only the single-player endless mode available for offline play.

182914.overview: This special release of Puzzle Bobble 3 is modified to exclusively support online multiplayer functionality via the Sega Saturn Modem and XBand service. Released at a lower price, most of the single-player content has been removed from this version, with only a short demo of the standard puzzle mode available for offline play.

182956.overview:
This bundle includes three pieces of software for exclusive use with the Sega Saturn Modem, collected onto one disc:

• Habitat II (online virtual world game, previously only sold bundled with a keyboard accessory)
• Pad Nifty 1.1 (message board browser software, previously only sold bundled with the Modem accessory)
• An internet browser application

200912.overview: Pachi-Slot Kanzen Kouryaku Uni-Colle '97: Universal Collection is a pachi-slot (Japanese slot machine) simulation game featuring digital recreations of eight real-life pachi-slot machines made by Universal and its subsidiaries: Baby Angel 2, Getter Mouse, Frozen Nights, Taco Slot, CC Angel, Dunk Shoot 2, Super Mog Mog 2, and Cranky Condor. Each machine is faithfully recreated, and the player can choose from six different manufacturer's settings to practice various configurations. The game includes detailed stat tracking for each machine.

462977.overview: The SEGA Saturn version (Going under the name Prime Time NFL '96) was also announced to release the same time as the 32X version, but was delayed to March 1996 according to Intelligent Gamers Fusion (Going under the name Prime Time NFL).  The game was delayed again to winter 1996 according to the 8th issue of volume 4 of GameFan magazine, where many screenshots of the game were showcased. before being announced that it had been cancelled.

470280.overview: In 1995, Digital Pictures began development on what would become Prize Fighter: Heavyweight Edition for the Sega Saturn.  Intended for release in 1996, it was ultimately cancelled due to the closure of Digital Pictures that same year.
